## Software

**SECFC: Survey-Embedded Carbon Footprint Calculator.** An open-source R package for estimating carbon footprints from lifestyle survey responses. [[Documentation](https://jianing-d.github.io/SECFC/)] [[Interactive app](https://ziqianxia.shinyapps.io/secfc/)]

The linked files are preprint versions and have not been formally published. The carbon-labeling link points to an earlier version of the manuscript currently under major revision at *PNAS Nexus*.
